issue.title: New Project wizard — add or create projects from Admin Center ▸ Projects
issue.description: Pressing `n` on Admin Center ▸ Projects opens a beautiful three-stage New Project wizard (Source › Configure › Review). The user picks a provider, then either adds a repository SASE ranks as likely (local clones, unregistered repos in their GitHub owners, linked repos, disabled projects) or creates a brand-new repository through the provider plugin with every `gh repo create` option reachable. The project is registered enabled, set up so agents can launch in it, and ends on a Ready screen. The same behavior ships as `sase project suggest | add | create`, the CLI every frontend shares.
